scope: CUDA-specific execution changes on one host, serial warm runs of the same PCM / weights / context; each row compares two settings or two consecutive commits; not SDR or quality evaluation
platform: Linux 5.14 x86_64 (Rocky 9.2), Xeon E5-2673 v3 12C/24T, 15 GB; NVIDIA Tesla P4 8 GB (sm_61, driver 535.288.01, CUDA 12.2, 1113 MHz application clock); Rust 1.92.0, Burn 0.21.0, CubeCL 0.10.0

entries.workload: MDX KARA 2, one native chunk, autotune already cached
entries.note: without a compilation cache CubeCL CUDA recompiles every kernel with NVRTC in each process

entries.change: PTX cache partitioned per model file (commit 6865c13)
entries.workload: warm runs after all models were cached
entries.note: CubeCL deserializes the whole CBOR cache (68 MB for all models) at start-up, about 1.2 s; first run of a new partition recompiles once (KARA 2 12.2 s, Leap short 27.3 s)

entries.change: MDX convolution strategy (unchanged default: GEMM on GPUs)
entries.note: Pascal has no tensor cores, CubeCL falls back to direct convolution

entries.change: --linear-layout auto flattens projections on CUDA (commit aa28258)
entries.workload: model call per chunk, batched -> flattened
entries.parity: unchanged on CUDA for all four RoFormer models (cuda-parity.json)

entries.change: weights SHA-256 overlapped with parsing / upload (commit fa6efbf)
entries.note: sha2 runs at about 160 MB/s on this CPU (no SHA extensions); hashing the 830 MB Deux package alone takes about 5.2 s, so Deux stays hash-bound; see cuda-benchmark.json for more load samples

entries.reference: CPU Flex, same chunk: vocals RMS 0.1826, peak 1.0577
entries.note: before the guard the 1024 / 2048 runs exited 0 with wrong stems; the 2048 run only looked faster because attention was never computed. With the guard both fail with an out-of-memory hint and publish nothing

entries.change: HyperACE SegmModel ungrouped convolutions as patch gather + GEMM on CUDA (commit c252cdf)
entries.workload: hyperace-v2-voc, model call per chunk, --conv-strategy backend -> default (gemm)
entries.note: 17 direct-convolution launches were 13.9% (short) / 9.4% (native) of GPU time in cuda-profile.json; depthwise layers keep Burn conv2d; CUDA parity unchanged (inst 7.53e-6 / 117.30 dB)

entries.change: rejected: Burn fused attention (autotuned flash-unit / fallback), per group tile
entries.workload: leap-xe-voc, model call per chunk, warm
entries.note: outputs identical to 4 digits; slower on Pascal, not kept

entries.workload: leap-xe-voc short chunk transformer GEMMs (16 depths x time / frequency axes)
entries.note: CubeCL time from nsys (cuda-profile.json, matmul share of GPU kernel time, includes the small band / mask GEMMs); cuBLAS from PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121 on the same GPU with TF32 off. CubeCL has no tensor-core-free tiled GEMM comparable to cuBLAS on Pascal
